task_description: Fix the language switching system so that switching EN/Khmer (ខ្មែរ) affects ALL pages — home, products listing, product detail, and cart. Pages are async server components that cannot use useLanguage(). Fix by splitting each page into a server component (data-fetching) + a client content component (rendering with useLanguage()). Also add missing translation keys and translate strings currently hardcoded in shared components (AddToCartButton, SortSelect, QuantitySelector, CartItemRow).
